marginRationale: Observed closed-bucket availability lag lower-bound max 5.181s (n=50, not P99) + 2s engineering margin → settlement target ≥8s.
justification: B.4 evidence: 53 exact-origin aggregate bucket observations appeared later; 26/53 definitely excluded at 2s overlap. Counterfactual at settlement=8s + overlap=6s: LOWER_BOUND recoverable ~53/53, missed ~0. Overlap-only (0s delay, 6s overlap) temporal recovery LOWER_BOUND ~53 but queries live edge without settlement — duplicate pressure HIGH and unsettled-horizon risk remain. Periodic deep recovery sweep recommended because OBSERVED_MISSED_BUCKET_COUNT_IS_LOWER_BOUND=YES and zero-result windows not reconstructible.

policyArchitectureOptions.label: 0s settlement delay + larger overlap only
policyArchitectureOptions.dataCompleteness: Improves temporal re-query of prior windows but still queries live edge — late buckets near horizon remain exposed.
policyArchitectureOptions.queryCost: High duplicate fraction (~15s / ~7.8s window ≈ VERY_HIGH pressure).
policyArchitectureOptions.providerLoad: Elevated — wide overlap on every cycle.
policyArchitectureOptions.failureRecovery: Weak for buckets excluded before overlap reaches them.
policyArchitectureOptions.drivingIntelligenceSuitability: Poor alone — does not address unsettled aggregate horizon.

policyArchitectureOptions.label: Provider settlement delay + moderate overlap
policyArchitectureOptions.dataCompleteness: Addresses both unsettled live-edge buckets and watermark recovery gap (B.4 root cause).
policyArchitectureOptions.latency: ~8s behind real time for HF historical surface.
policyArchitectureOptions.providerLoad: Moderate — fewer live-edge misses than today.
policyArchitectureOptions.complexity: Moderate — extend resolveHfActualQueryTo with settlement horizon.
policyArchitectureOptions.failureRecovery: Good for observed 50 closed late buckets; residual misses need sweep.
policyArchitectureOptions.drivingIntelligenceSuitability: Recommended baseline for episode reconstruction confidence.

policyArchitectureOptions.label: Settlement delay + overlap + periodic deep recovery sweep
policyArchitectureOptions.dataCompleteness: Best LOWER_BOUND coverage — fast loop for freshness + idempotent sweep for missed closed buckets.
policyArchitectureOptions.latency: Fast loop ~8s behind; sweep replays older closed intervals asynchronously.
policyArchitectureOptions.queryCost: Fast loop moderate; sweep adds bounded extra queries (not every cycle).
policyArchitectureOptions.duplicateVolume: Moderate fast loop + controlled sweep duplicates (fingerprint-idempotent).
policyArchitectureOptions.providerLoad: Spread over time — preferable to huge continuous overlap.
policyArchitectureOptions.drivingIntelligenceSuitability: Best fit for RD004 / DI episode confidence requirements.

policyArchitectureOptions.label: Dual-watermark (data watermark vs query coverage + recovery cursor)
policyArchitectureOptions.dataCompleteness: Separates persisted DATA watermark from QUERY COVERAGE and optional RECOVERY cursor (extends 3A.3.2 model).
policyArchitectureOptions.latency: Same as Policy C with clearer observability.
policyArchitectureOptions.queryCost: Similar to C with better dedupe targeting.
policyArchitectureOptions.duplicateVolume: Moderate — idempotent physical fingerprint absorbs revisions.
policyArchitectureOptions.failureRecovery: Excellent auditability for late revisions and sweeps.
policyArchitectureOptions.drivingIntelligenceSuitability: Preferred long-term architecture if implementation cost acceptable.

drivingIntelligenceImpact.rule: Until recovery policy is fixed, missing HF evidence must lower reconstruction confidence — no interpolation across giant gaps.
drivingIntelligenceImpact.accelerationReconstruction: Large gaps inflate inferred acceleration between sparse points; confidence must be LOW/INTERVAL_CENSORED.
drivingIntelligenceImpact.decelerationReconstruction: Stop/decel episodes lose intermediate samples — peak severity and duration uncertain.
drivingIntelligenceImpact.stopLaunchBoundaries: B.3/B.4 show interval-censored transitions; incomplete HF worsens boundary placement.
drivingIntelligenceImpact.peakSeverity: True local peaks may be absent from sealed capture — attenuation metrics biased.
drivingIntelligenceImpact.episodeDuration: Duration confidence degrades when cadence median ~10.6s vs provider ~1-2s capability.
drivingIntelligenceImpact.smoothing: Preprocessing cannot invent missing provider buckets; smoothing masks gaps without fixing evidence.
drivingIntelligenceImpact.falseNegatives: Legacy detectors may miss dynamics between sparse samples — not validated FN without denser HF.
drivingIntelligenceImpact.episodeConfidence: Episode confidence scores must incorporate HF completeness / gap penalties.

fastHfLoop.purpose: Near-real-time HF with settled horizon + bounded overlap.

periodicRecoverySweep.purpose: Idempotent replay of older closed intervals to recover buckets missed by watermark race (lower-bound residual).
periodicRecoverySweep.idempotency: physicalSampleFingerprint + provider revision semantics — duplicates absorbed, revisions recorded separately.

advantages: Avoids continuous VERY_HIGH overlap duplicate pressure.
Targets residual definitely-missed buckets from B.4 lower bound.
disadvantages: Sweep window selection must avoid query-origin confusion in analytics.
Residual zero-result windows still not reconstructible from sealed export alone.

uniqueInformationCoverage.explicitDistinction: Late replay-new rows are aggregate bucket observations, not claimed unique ECU physical samples.

safetyMarginAnalysis.note: No statistically validated P99 from 50 closed samples — margin is engineering judgment, not provider SLA.
